mapper.select: SELECT ANSWER_SEQ as answerSeq, EVENT_SEQ as eventSeq, QUESTION_SEQ as questionSeq, USER_SEQ as userSeq, ITEM_SEQ as itemSeq, QUESTION_TYPE as questionType, QUESTION_TYPE_DETAIL as questionTypeDetail, ANSWER as answer, FILE_PATH as filePath, REG_DATE as regDate, REG_ID as regId FROM SURVEY_ANSWER WHERE EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND USER_SEQ = #{userSeq} ORDER BY QUESTION_SEQ
